- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There have been numerous instances of cultural clashes regarding beauty standards, such as the reverence for overweight bodies in some African cultures versus the ideal of thinness in Western cultures.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cultural differences in beauty standards can lead to clashes when people from different backgrounds interact.
